title: 長距離輸水管水錘分析
titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
summary: 本課從穩態水頭線開始，依序分析彈性波速、速度突變、邊界反射、關閉曲線及停泵慣性，再把低壓空穴、氣室熱力、數值網格與疲勞接回完整輸水系統。每個算例都分清初步量級與完整瞬變模型，並要求壓力、流量、閥位及時間基準互相驗證。
summaryEn: Starting with the steady hydraulic grade, this course examines elastic wave speed, velocity changes, reflections, closure shape and pump inertia, then connects cavities, air-vessel thermodynamics, numerical grids and fatigue to the complete water-main system. Each example distinguishes a scale estimate from a complete transient model and checks pressure, flow, valve position and timing against one another.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合算例假設水密度1000 kg/m³、波速1000 m/s與快速減速1.0 m/s，第一波壓升為1.00 MPa。僅將波速增加10%至1100 m/s，其餘條件固定，壓升變成1.10 MPa，同時5000 m管段的往返時間由10.0 s降為9.09 s。這顯示參數改變同時影響幅值與時序，不能只用較大波速替所有不確定度保守包絡。再以三個監測點核對到時、初始壓力與峰值，另列反射、空穴與閥門曲線尚待求解的項目。這些數字不代表任何列名工程的實測或操作門檻。
workedExample.textEn: An original integrated example assumes water density 1000 kg/m³, speed 1000 m/s and rapid deceleration 1.0 m/s, giving a first-wave pressure rise of 1.00 MPa. Increasing only wave speed by 10% to 1100 m/s raises the increment to 1.10 MPa and shortens the round trip in a 5000 m reach from 10.0 to 9.09 s. A parameter change therefore affects amplitude and timing together; a higher speed is not automatically a conservative envelope for all uncertainties. Check arrivals, initial pressure and peaks at three monitoring points, while separately listing reflections, cavities and valve characteristics requiring further solution. These numbers are not measurements or operating thresholds from any named project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」與「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" and "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩態水頭基線」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steady hydraulic baseline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。長管摩阻、局部閥損與泵揚程共同決定速度，而高程圖決定每處壓力水頭；相同總壓降並不表示沿線最低壓位置相同。本單元的達西公式假設滿管單相穩定流，所給摩阻係數已另行確定；它不能描述壓力波到達前後的瞬間局部加速度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩態水頭基線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance. Flow and boundary levels cannot be chosen independently when they are incompatible. Distributed friction, local valve losses and pump head determine velocity, while the elevation profile determines pressure head at each location. Equal total head loss does not imply the same location of minimum pressure. The Darcy example assumes steady, single-phase full-pipe flow with a separately established friction factor. It does not describe local acceleration as a pressure wave arrives. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steady hydraulic baseline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩態水頭基線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steady hydraulic baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩態水頭基線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steady hydraulic baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩態水頭基線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steady hydraulic baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。先用未參與校準的穩態時段驗證水頭線，再將可信初值交給瞬變模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately. Validate the hydraulic grade using a steady period withheld from calibration before transferring initial conditions to the transient model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一張包含流量、基準高程及損失項的能量帳，標示哪些資料為量測、哪些為假設；要求相鄰管段交界的水頭與流量相容後才比較瞬變情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare an energy ledger containing flow, datum and losses, marking measured and assumed quantities. Require compatible head and flow at adjacent pipe interfaces before comparing transient scenarios.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Validate the hydraulic grade using a steady period withheld from calibration before transferring initial conditions to the transient model.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare an energy ledger containing flow, datum and losses, marking measured and assumed quantities. Require compatible head and flow at adjacent pipe interfaces before comparing transient scenarios.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification"?
options: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。
optionsEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩態水頭基線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steady hydraulic baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Such startup errors may then be misidentified as physical reflections or actual water hammer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本單元的達西公式假設滿管單相穩定流，所給摩阻係數已另行確定；它不能描述壓力波到達前後的瞬間局部加速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not describe local acceleration as a pressure wave arrives.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。
knowledge.textEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Such startup errors may then be misidentified as physical reflections or actual water hammer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

knowledge.text: 閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。定水頭水庫與封閉端對壓力波具有不同反射條件，分岔還會依阻抗分配波動；把整條管線視為單一長度可能掩蓋支線的較短共振路徑。
knowledge.textEn: The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. Length and wave speed establish this round-trip scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。
閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。
關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。
optionsEn: Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories.
The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back.
Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main.
quiz.explanation: 閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返時間與邊界反射」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip timing and reflections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻管長L=5000 m、波速a=1000 m/s，往返時間Tr=2L/a=10.0 s；關閥時間Tc=3 s時，Tc/Tr=0.30。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform length L=5000 m and speed a=1000 m/s. Round-trip time Tr=2L/a=10.0 s; for closure time Tc=3 s, Tc/Tr=0.30. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實際管段與連通圖建立到時表，核對水庫、盲端及支線位置，再比較多支壓力計的首波和回波。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an arrival-time table from actual reaches and connectivity, verifying reservoirs, dead ends and branches against first and returning waves at several pressure sensors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返時間與邊界反射」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用實際管段與連通圖建立到時表，核對水庫、盲端及支線位置，再比較多支壓力計的首波和回波。若回波順序不符，先查閥門連通狀態，不直接調整阻尼掩蓋拓樸錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an arrival-time table from actual reaches and connectivity, verifying reservoirs, dead ends and branches against first and returning waves at several pressure sensors. If echo ordering disagrees, investigate valve connectivity before adjusting damping to conceal a topology error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作一段水庫至閥門與一段含支線管路的時間距離圖，逐一標明反射邊界。使用到時順序辨認模型結構，再用幅值評估阻抗與損失參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare time-distance diagrams for a reservoir-to-valve reach and a branched main, labeling every reflecting boundary. Use arrival order to assess model structure before using amplitudes to assess impedance and losses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把開放水庫端設成封閉端會改變壓力反射符號，回波可能由抵消變成疊加；即使首波幅值正確，後續峰值仍會完全失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Modeling an open reservoir as a closed boundary changes the pressure-reflection sign and can turn cancellation into reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界反射機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip timing and reflections mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「往返時間與邊界反射」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip timing and reflections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把開放水庫端設成封閉端會改變壓力反射符號，回波可能由抵消變成疊加；即使首波幅值正確，後續峰值仍會完全失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Modeling an open reservoir as a closed boundary changes the pressure-reflection sign and can turn cancellation into reinforcement. Later peaks can therefore be seriously wrong even when the first-wave amplitude matches. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Boundary dynamics can also change with valve position and water level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 關閉曲線與慢變近似機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure shape and slow-change approximation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「關閉曲線與慢變近似」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。末段的小位移可能造成最大的流量變化，因此相同總時間的兩條關閉曲線可能有不同峰值；慢變估式適合分辨慣性尺度，不能代替真實閥特性與管線反射。下式只作簡單水庫至閥門管線、假設近似均勻減速且關閉較慢的量級比較；不保證為實際峰值上限，也不是推薦關閉時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉曲線與慢變近似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position. Small movement near closure can produce the largest flow change, giving two schedules with equal duration different peaks. A slow-change estimate helps isolate inertia but cannot replace actual valve characteristics and reflected waves. The expression is a scale comparison for a simple reservoir-to-valve main with approximately uniform deceleration and slow closure. It is not a guaranteed peak bound or a recommended closure time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure shape and slow-change approximation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停泵慣性與能量尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對馬達、聯軸器與泵的等效轉動慣量，取得可用的四象限性能資料，並同步檢視歷史停泵的轉速、電力與壓力紀錄。量測缺乏逆流資料時，應保留模型區間而非外推正常曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check equivalent inertia for the motor, coupling and pump, obtain available four-quadrant performance data, and align historical rundown speed, electrical power and pressure records. Where reverse-flow observations are absent, retain model ranges rather than extrapolating the normal operating curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：列出停泵模型需要的慣量、性能圖與止回閥資料，指出能量估式缺少的動態耦合。以假設較大慣量比較能量尺度，另行說明為何峰值不必按比例下降。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List inertia, machine characteristics and check-valve data required for rundown modeling, identifying dynamic couplings omitted by the energy estimate. Compare a larger assumed inertia and explain why pressure peaks need not fall proportionally.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵當作停電即零流量的邊界會製造不實急停，反之忽略止回閥關閉又會漏掉逆流截斷衝擊；兩種錯誤可能在單點壓力上互相抵消。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A zero-flow boundary immediately after power loss creates an artificial stop, while omitting check-valve closure misses reverse-flow interruption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 停泵慣性與能量尺度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump rundown inertia and energy scale mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停泵慣性與能量尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump rundown inertia and energy scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵當作停電即零流量的邊界會製造不實急停，反之忽略止回閥關閉又會漏掉逆流截斷衝擊；兩種錯誤可能在單點壓力上互相抵消。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A zero-flow boundary immediately after power loss creates an artificial stop, while omitting check-valve closure misses reverse-flow interruption. These two errors can misleadingly cancel at one pressure monitoring point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例把全部初始轉動能假想轉成固定水力功率，忽略效率、摩擦及揚程變化，只得到比較時間而非實際滑行停機時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its time is a comparison scale, not actual coastdown duration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」與「氣室壓縮與調壓容量機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" and "Air-vessel compression and storage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低壓與水柱分離」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low pressure and column separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。空穴形成與再閉合會改變波速、流量連續性及二次壓峰，不能讓數值解無限制下降到負絕對壓；溶解氣體析出又與純蒸氣空穴具有不同時間尺度。比較必須使用同一溫度下的絕對壓力與蒸氣壓；正的差值只代表此瞬間尚有壓力裕度，不證明所有位置都不空化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低壓與水柱分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column. Cavity formation and collapse alter wave speed, continuity and secondary pressure peaks. A numerical solution must not extend without limit into negative absolute pressure, while dissolved-gas release has different time scales from pure vapor cavities. Compare absolute pressure and vapor pressure at the same temperature. A positive difference indicates a margin at that instant only, not absence of cavitation everywhere. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low pressure and column separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設局部絕對壓力pabs=30 kPa、該溫度蒸氣壓pv=2.3 kPa，裕度pabs−pv=27.7 kPa；兩者都不是表壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume local absolute pressure pabs=30 kPa and vapor pressure pv=2.3 kPa at the stated temperature.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低壓與水柱分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low pressure and column separation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。

steps.titleEn: Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低壓與水柱分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low pressure and column separation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設局部絕對壓力pabs=30 kPa、該溫度蒸氣壓pv=2.3 kPa，裕度pabs−pv=27.7 kPa；兩者都不是表壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume local absolute pressure pabs=30 kPa and vapor pressure pv=2.3 kPa at the stated temperature. The margin pabs−pv=27.7 kPa; neither value is gauge pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將高程、氣壓、液溫及壓力計零點一併整理，確認低壓量測範圍足以涵蓋預測值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assemble elevation, atmospheric pressure, liquid temperature and sensor-zero information, confirming that the instrument range covers predicted lows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 氣室藉由可壓縮氣體吸收或供應水量，氣體壓力與體積沿熱力路徑變化。快速過程可能較接近絕熱，慢過程可能交換更多熱量，實際指數須依設備與時間尺度選擇；接管損失、預充狀態與水位行程也限制可用調壓量，不能只看容器總容積。多方關係必須使用絕對壓力，且本例假設氣體質量固定；未含氣體溶解、熱交換細節及接管水力損失，不構成容器選型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣室壓縮與調壓容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The polytropic relation uses absolute pressure and assumes constant gas mass here. It omits gas dissolution, detailed heat transfer and connecting-pipe losses and is not a vessel selection. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。為了容納不同管長而插值可能引入數值耗散，造成計算峰值變小且看似穩定；這種人工平滑不能當作物理摩阻的證據，應與實際阻尼和量測頻寬分開評估。本例僅核對單一均勻管段的Courant數；C=1不保證所有非線性邊界或空穴模型都準確，仍需網格收斂與質量守恆檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「特徵線網格與數值耗散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments. Interpolation used to accommodate different pipe lengths can introduce numerical damping, reducing peaks and making results appear stable. Such artificial smoothing is not evidence of physical friction and must be assessed separately from real damping and measurement bandwidth. The example checks the Courant number for one uniform reach only. C=1 does not guarantee accuracy for nonlinear boundaries or cavity models, so convergence and mass balance remain necessary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Characteristic grids and numerical damping” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every stress cycle below yield means fatigue is impossible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. Missing frequent smaller events also makes cumulative deterioration appear to be an isolated failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環壓力與管殼疲勞機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cyclic pressure and shell fatigue mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。
只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage.
Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure.
quiz.explanation: 用平均厚度或平均壓力取代局部最薄處及循環範圍，可能嚴重低估焊接細節損傷；漏掉頻繁小事件也會把長期累積效應誤認為偶發破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing minimum local thickness and cycle range with average thickness or pressure can greatly understate welded-detail damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
